delivery_names.note: The launcher is an extensionless native ELF64 executable; library filenames retain .dll. No Wine dependency.

scope: Startup/loading, introduction/poem, main menu/footer, About, Credits, setup display fields, saved-character empty messages/title, character-creation menu/culture/sex/name, ancestor controls, Village source records, main-game HUD/calendar/world labels at individually recorded native calls. All 17 culture encyclopedia topics, culture-selection previews, encyclopedia heading/navigation/help and both map culture legends at native display consumers. All eleven farewell fields at endgame's native panel, showtext, centext and button calls.
ownership: Native UI retains layout, wrapping, centering, controls, input, hit testing, background, caching and animation. Chinese glyphs draw synchronously inside native text leaves; no pixel tracking or text replay.

native_density.resources: Native screen, BufSurface, SCREENSAVE, SCREENBUFFY, GAMESAVE, MENUBUFFER, named grabsurface caches, fade surfaces and HeadingBoxSurface/HeadingBoxSoftRen share the canvas output ratio. Asset pixel domains retain their original dimensions.
native_density.density_source: Window-target logical presentation scale or SDL_GetRendererOutputSize at confirmed native creation/main-menu boundaries; native 800x600 raster remains the minimum when output is smaller.

pending_boundaries: Resize-driven complete screen reconstruction is established for the main menu only. The map culture legend and MapviewMainTex obtain current output density at native map rebuild. Other active pages keep the last established screen density until the next main-menu boundary; old bitmap caches are not text-replayed.
Linux showtext preserves its four native shadow calls, but the shadow budget is not yet propagated into font calibration and external width calls. This style envelope remains pending.
Pure refresh of setup body, already-dimmed profile panels, saved-character windows, ancestor pages and current Village page remains tied to native reconstruction.
Linux in-process module retirement/publication protocol is not implemented; Windows Reload is rejected for Linux.

Culture encyclopedia immediate language refresh remains unimplemented; its persistent heading and navigation retain the entry language. Map culture legends consume the current language at native map reconstruction.

Farewell consumes the selected language at its native construction calls. Its wait loop has no confirmed pure redraw entry; Shift+F10 does not reconstruct already drawn farewell pixels. endgame is never re-entered for refresh because it owns music, fades, input waiting and process exit.
runtime_verification: Not performed; launching the game, running artifacts and tests are prohibited.

farewell.page: endgame at 0x10e790, called from main at 0xa8f0
farewell.panel: 0x10e81e -> winbox(0x1471a0), text in R8; seventh argument remains on the original native stack
farewell.dedication: 0x10e9f5 -> centext(0x13ea90), text in RCX; native word flow and centering consume extended width
farewell.button: 0x10eaa1 -> Piirra_Nappain(0x144fb0), text in RDX; native tile count and cursor advance consume extended width
farewell.drawing: Synchronous glyphs into native screen at its actual output density, using the established software target path. Native colors, shadow calls, frame, image, caches, fades, input wait and shutdown remain owned by the game.

culture_information.body_consumer: 0x514c8 -> link_show; source identity is the native FILE byte offset before fgetstr(150)
culture_information.links: Native English topic keys and ASCII aliases retained; matched display words use the same translation at native width and showtext calls.
culture_information.drawing: Native screen output-density path for encyclopedia/previews/legacy map. Modern map legend uses the native surface at return 0x10ac3b, CultureDialogTexture, MapviewMainTex and window at matching output density; synchronous glyph rendering only.
culture_information.map_legends: Eleven culture names and both titles at kulttuuri_info(0x108940) and compile_CultureDialogTexture(0x10ac10). Native map reconstruction at 0x10b0c6 rebuilds the legend and its full-resolution target; native layout, colors and resource ownership remain unchanged.
culture_information.language: The encyclopedia keeps the language selected when opened; Shift+F10 takes effect when the browser is next opened.
